packet.title: EXI streams, datatypes and string tables
packet.summary: Bit and byte streams, the built-in EXI datatype representations and the string tables, the parts both codecs share.

body.p: After 8.2. EXI 1.0, sections 7 ("Representing Event Content") and 7.3 ("String Table").

item.p: Mechanism: src/exi_stream.c, a bit reader over a byte view and a bit writer over allocator memory, both with byte alignment (n-bit unsigned integers in whole bytes, least significant first, section 7.1.9); src/exi_datatype.c, Binary, Boolean, Decimal, Float, Integer, Unsigned Integer, Date-Time, n-bit Unsigned Integer, Enumeration, List and String, each in both directions, with their canonical forms (Canonical EXI, 4.5); src/exi_string_table.c, the URI, prefix, local-name and value partitions, global and local, with valueMaxLength and valuePartitionCapacity (its round-robin replacement, 7.3.3), their initial entries (Appendix D).
Owns: those files, tests/exi_stream_test.c, tests/exi_datatype_test.c, tests/exi_string_table_test.c, their part of src/exi_internal.h.
Done when: the unit tests cover every datatype at its limits (unsigned integers past 64 bits, negative zero decimals, float special values, every date-time kind), and the gate script passes.
